candidate.implementation_scope: raw adapter field retention + pure residual gate + native FGO factor filtering + diagnostics; no estimator parameter search

source_contract.residual_rule: accept finite receiver-only D factor iff abs(residual_mps - dclk_mps / observation_interval_s) <= 3.0 m/s
source_contract.observation_interval: median positive adjacent native GPST epoch interval, matching gt.Gobs.estInterval; first/isolated epoch uses the same global interval only when finite
source_contract.missing_drift: reject the D row for this opt-in screen; never estimate from truth, WLS, or a coordinate
source_contract.status_and_pair_masks: unchanged; this candidate only adds the residual-stage D screen
source_contract.weighting: unchanged from the selected base lane; no SNR or Huber parameter changes

evaluation_protocol.development_truth_after_seal: same already-used Pixel7Pro development ground_truth only, one evaluator process/read if structural gates pass
evaluation_protocol.gate: candidate must remain finite/deterministic/complete, improve or remain non-inferior on all four local diagnostics versus the frozen Phase12 base, preserve coverage and physical continuity; otherwise No-Go

commands.evaluation: python3 apps/gnss.py smartphone-native-gnss-pdc-evaluate --candidate <sealed candidate> --run-manifest <sealed manifest> --ground-truth <already-used development ground_truth.csv> --recovery-authorization <phase23 authorization> --phone <route/phone> --output-json <score.json>
